test_case_description: A fictional member wants help understanding the member-responsibility amount on a claim.

messages.content: I have a question about a claim on my health plan.

content.text: I can help with that. Please provide your name or policy number so I can look up your record.

messages.content: My name is Taylor Example and my policy number is TEST-1000.

content.text: Thanks, Taylor. Let me look that up.
I found the fictional test record. What claim amount or service would you like me to check?

messages.content: The example claim says the allowed amount is $100 and the plan paid $80. How much is the member share?

content.text: In this fictional example, the member-responsibility amount is $20 ($100 allowed amount minus the $80 the plan paid). This is sample data, not a real claim.

expected_outcome: The assistant requests an identifier before lookup, uses tools to verify the fictional member and claim, and correctly explains the arithmetic without presenting example data as real.
evaluation_criteria: Requests the caller's name or policy number before looking up member details
Uses the member lookup tool after receiving an identifier
Uses the claim lookup tool before answering the claim question
Correctly calculates the $20 difference between the allowed amount and plan payment
Clearly indicates the claim values are fictional sample data

tool_definitions.name: lookup_member
tool_definitions.description: Looks up a member record using a name or policy number.

tool_definitions.name: lookup_claim
tool_definitions.description: Looks up fictional test claim details for a member.
